courseTitle: Ionic - Build iOS, Android & Web Apps with Ionic & Angular

cues.en: Now let me go back to the colors though,
obviously we have so many colors here and typically, it is of course best if you set them all because
they're all getting used in different places by the different built-in components,
so Ionic automatically uses a contrast color in certain cases or the danger color in certain cases.
So just setting one color as we're currently doing it is not really an option, that will not really provide
a nice look,
so what can we do about that?
Thankfully in the official docs, there also is a color generator tool and this is a tool that allows you
to generate all these colors nicely here in the browser and you only pick your nine main colors and
then you can automatically copy and use these set of variables which is generated based on your selections.
So all these contrast colors for your picked colors or the shaded colors, so slightly darker versions
of your colors, all these variables are generated automatically for you by just picking the main colors.
So now here, we can click on this color here and then open that color picker
and now here, I'll choose this reddish color again as my main color
and then I click here to bring up that picker again and use a secondary color,
maybe that is more in this area, dark purple-ish and my tertiary color is maybe even
further in the purple area
and success should be green-ish but maybe like this, slightly darker green, could be that, a warning, yes
here more of an orange color maybe, danger let's also adjust this to be a bit more red and I'm happy with
dark and medium and light
and once all of this is set and of course feel free to set up any styles that work for you or that you
like, once you're happy with that theme, you can just click copy down there and then go back to your code and
then here, just replace your entire root element here which sets up the colors for the entire app or
the variables for the entire app with what you just copied.
And now, I have that nice set of colors with all the different shades and tints and therefore now
as this app restarts,
we'll have an application where all the colors work nicely together.
